notes.title: Town Extra Update | Pickup Trash Radio | Sandbox Photo Mode
notes.content:
Hello Again, So This Update You Probably Didn't Ask For But I Did It Anyway.

I'm Probably Gonna Add Driving In The Town Extra Soon But I Wanted You To Dip Your Feet In The Water First With Some Cars In The Town. One Of Them Plays The Radio.

Sandbox Now Has A Fully Updated Everything So It'll Be A Lot More Like The Base Game To Play With Photo Mode.

That's Basically It, See Ya.

- Newboon

notes.title: Recoded Movement System | BETA Photo Mode | New Player Model
notes.content:
Hey! I Know Right?
A Whole Day Since An Update? K Let Me Just Say That This Took Me From 11 Or 12 This Morning To 10pm Today.

Basically The Main Game Got A Major Revamp, Not Done Yet But Still. You Can Now Mess Around With A (Almost) Fully Functional Photo Mode, Still Some Bugs With It.

There Was Also A Revamp With The Cups, You Might Have Kicked Them Around A Bit Before And Saw Ice Coming Out. Well Back When I Made That Code I Didn't Know How To Make It Be So It Was When It Was Upside Down It Leaked, So I Just Made It On Contact.

BUT NOW I Have Made It So It Works Like I Always Wanted It To. This Update Also Revamps The Entire UI For The Main Game And Most Extras. Plus A Revamped Movement System Which Is Also In Beta.
There Are Now Camera Shakes, And Working On Controller Force Feedback To Match With Them.

My storage might be down to 1mb But it is pretty optimized for you guys, And Jeez This Game Is Getting Kinda Fat Ain't It, Thinking By The End Of The Month It'll Be About A Gigabyte.

This games like a playground to make and to play in so I hope you like the new update, I'm gonna test it on a less powerful computer tonight so I can check for bugs. Thanks for playing!!!

- Newboon

notes.title: Graphical Update And Better Gameplay
notes.content:
I Noticed The Games Graphics Looked Kind Of Bland And Honestly Outdated, So I Fixed It Up In Every Level And Tried My Best To Get The Lighting Better.

Colors Should Be More Vibrant, And There Is Now The Ability To Crouch And Sprint.
Rethinking Leaving The Game.

Keep The Community Strong For Me, I'll Keep On Working Unless I Get Burnout.

But Honestly This Update Was Fun.
Hope You Like The Graphics.

And Hope You Love The New Font!

From Newboon

notes.title: Pickup Trash Simulator Remastered Price Change
notes.content:
Pickup Trash Simulator Remastered Has Been Out For Almost A Year.
Which Is Awesome, But With The Bigger Updates Coming And The Rise In Prices I'm Changing The Game To 4.99 USD On May 3rd.

Hopefully That Can Fund A Few More Of My Projects While Funding The Story For This Game.

I'm Planning On Fixing A Lot Of The Bugs Soon, Thanks For Your Understanding.

- Newboon

notes.title: What's Coming In Final Update 2?
notes.content:
So You Probably Saw 1/3 For The Last Update.

I'm Going To Keep The 3rd Update Mostly A Secret, But I Will Tell You What The Second One Is Because Of How Massive It Will Be For The Game.

I've Been Working On A Script For The Games Story Mode Which Will Be The 2nd Final Update,
The Story Won't Be Too Serious It's Mostly Comedic, I Don't Really Have A Planned Release Date But I Know If A Part Of It Isn't Good - Amazing Or Boring It'll Probably Be Cut Out.

I Will Also Probably Voice Almost ALL Characters.

The Story Mode Won't Be As Family Friendly As The Game Is Normally, There Won't Be Swearing Or Extreme Gore But There Will Be Some Comedic Violence And Barely Even Mild Language.

Since This Is A Big Update It Will Take Some Time, Especially Because I'm Putting As Much Effort Into It As I Can.

You Might Not Know This But I Model Everything In The Game Myself, Which Takes Time.

So Far I Made A Few Walls, A Window And A Door.

No Spoilers So That's All I Will Say.


Other Things Final Update 2 Will Add Is Patches For The Game Itself Like,

Classic Extra In Sandbox Mode,

Updated Town Extra In Sandbox Mode (With Basketball Nets And Basketballs),

Audio Fixes.


That's All For Now,

See Ya

- Newboon

notes.title: Pickup Trash Simulator Final Update (1/3)
notes.content:
This Update Adds The Classic Extra, It Recreates The Look Of How The Original Game Looked.
This Update Is One Of The Three Final Updates Coming Out This Year. This Update Will Be The Smallest Out Of The Three.

One Of The Reasons I'm Leaving Game Development Is Because Of Storage Space, After The Update I Have 362 MB Left In My Drives All Together. Unreal Engine Takes Up A Lot Of Storage Even To Run.
Then To Build Lighting And Levels It's So Much For My PC.

This Update Adds A New Classic Mode And Basketball Hoops By Some Houses In The Town Extra.

notes.title: Thanks For The Support In My Game
notes.content:
I Am Happy With All Of Your Support On My Game, It Means Alot Because I Started Working On It Back When I Was 12 Well The Original. I Am Happy That People Are Leaving Good Reviews And Suggestions.

I Only Find It Fair That If You Give A Suggestion I Will Credit You Or Leave An Easter Egg In The Level Somehow.

I Read Every Review And Every Discussion I Am Happy That My Game Is So Well Received And If You Don't Enjoy The Game Feel Free To Leave A Bad Review. But If You Do Please Leave A Suggestion On What I Can Do To Make It Better.

I Think You Are All Great And Thanks For Enjoying My Little Indie Game.

Uhm I Don't Have Much More To Say. Feel Free To Comment On These Updates. I Appreciate You All.

Thanks Eday244 For Suggesting A Town I Enjoyed Making The Town And You Really Helped With More Ideas, I Thought I Made A Mistake Keeping Doing Game Development Till I Saw Your Review.

I'm Glad You Enjoyed My Game And I Hope To Do More Suggestions Later, I Know The Game Can Get Old, But I'm Gonna Add More Levels To Arcade Soon It Just Takes 3 Days A Level Because Of All The Visual Stuff.

I know this is a longer update note thingy, but yknow just wanted to tell you thank you and stuff, Oh I Wanna Credit Abox For One Of The Cups On The Pizza Box Art In The Town.


Thanks For Playing My Game

- Newboon

notes.title: Huge New Extra Added Plus Patches And Information On The Future Of The Game
notes.content:
[b]I've Been Working[/b] For 3 Months On A Arcade Extra That Is Huge, It Includes 3 Levels So Far Depending If It's Well Received.

You Play As A Dumpster Like That Minigame In Pickup Trash Simulator 2 Which None Have You Have Played,

I Know Pickup Trash Simulator Remastered Is Buggy, Achievements Broken On Release, Controller Support Being Added Post Release. Constant Patches On The Second Day Of The Game Being On Steam.

I'm Trying To Keep The Games Size Down, But The Game Doesn't Feel Finished.

It's Everything The Original Was And More. But I Have Been Reading Reviews And Discussions So Thank  You For Telling Me Issues With My Game.

I Am Trying To Make This Game The Best It Can Be.

Expect Updates To Be Less Frequent. If You Find Any Bugs That Aren't Fixed Put It In The Discussions Part Of The Game Page I Read Every Discussion And Review All Of You Write And Am Planning To Listen To Your Suggestions And Dislikes About The Game.

I Get There's Some Stuff I Can't Fix, But I Can Try.

[b]Anyway..[/b]

This Update Gives You A Whole New Extra, Your Goal Is To Stop An Evil Company From Turning Dumpsters Into Mailboxes,

3 Levels As I Said More If It's Well Received.

Fixed Some Stuff In The Base Game That Isn't Worth A Whole Page.

Anyway,
Enjoy The Update.


- Newboon Dev
